title: Rio Carnival
metaDescription: Rio Carnival: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Carnival.

overview.about: Rio Carnival is the world's biggest and most famous carnival, a days-long explosion of samba, costume and street parties before Lent. Its centrepiece is the competition between the city's samba schools, who parade elaborate floats and thousands of dancers through the purpose-built Sambadrome.
overview.nextEvent: The next Rio Carnival runs in the days before Lent, in February or March, across Rio de Janeiro. The headline samba-school parades take place in the Sambadrome, while hundreds of free street 'blocos' fill the city day and night.
